summary:
Main
Today's prices and today's data point in opposite directions. On prices: the DCE most-traded contract reclaimed 700 at 702.5yuan/mt (+0.50%), Qingdao port spot rose 2 yuan across the board except for flat IOCJ, and the port spot indices had the 65% up 2 yuan, the 61% up 1 and the 58% unchanged. On data: daily average hot metal across 242 mills fell to 2.3882 million mt (-6,100 mt WoW), with the blast furnace operating rate at 88.57% and capacity utilisation at 88.15%.
